answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 44713 Country: India Title: Masah on normal socks Question: Kindly let me know whether salah behind a person who makes wudhu by doing masah on normal socks will be valid or not? Answer ID: 44713 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 568/568/M=1434) If by normal socks you mean the prevalent cotton or nylon socks on which the conditions of masah are not found then masah is not lawful over them. And when wudhu is not valid then salah shall not be valid behind such imam. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
